#### What this PR does / why we need it:
The CQ's lending limit was unset the corresponding metric was set to 0.
However when lendingLimit is unset, the queue cannot lend more than it owns so it should be equal to the nominal quota value.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

## Walkthrough

Set cluster queue lending-limit metric to +Inf when `lendingLimit` is unset, update the metric help and reference docs to document +Inf behavior, and extend tests to validate lending-limit metrics across two cluster queues and label updates.

**Cluster Queue Lending-Limit Metrics**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Extended resync metrics test** <br> `pkg/cache/scheduler/cache_resync_metrics_test.go`|Add `math` import, create a second cluster queue with lending enabled, add `expectLendingLimit` helper, and assert lending-limit gauge behavior before and after a cluster queue custom label change.|
|**Metric implementation: +Inf fallback** <br> `pkg/cache/scheduler/clusterqueue.go`|In `reportResourceMetrics`, set lending metric to `math.Inf(1)` when `quota.LendingLimit` is `nil`; preserve configured value when set.|
|**Metric help and reference docs** <br> `pkg/metrics/metrics.go`, `site/content/en/docs/reference/metrics.md`|Update Prometheus gauge help text and reference docs to state that when `lendingLimit` is unset the metric reports `+Inf`.|

## Reviews

### Review by [@mimowo](https://github.com/mimowo) (commented) — 2026-06-11T12:30:47Z

- **pkg/cache/scheduler/clusterqueue.go:552** by [@mimowo](https://github.com/mimowo) — 2026-06-11T12:30:47Z
```diff
@@ -547,7 +547,10 @@ func (c *clusterQueue) reportResourceMetrics(fairSharingEnabled bool) {
 		} else {
 			borrowing = resourceFloat(fr.Resource, quota.BorrowingLimit.Int64())
 		}
-		if quota.LendingLimit != nil {
+		if quota.LendingLimit == nil {
+			// Unset lendingLimit means all nominal quota can be lent.
+			lending = nominal
```

  Hm, maybe it is better to use +inf too, to distiguish the case when this is set explicitly vs unset,
  
  This is similar case as for borrowingLimit - we could compute the precise "borrowable_capacity", and we could also introduce "landable_capacity". However, for now I think it makes sense to keep it undefined.

### Review by [@mszadkow](https://github.com/mszadkow) (commented) — 2026-06-11T15:30:49Z

- **pkg/cache/scheduler/clusterqueue.go:552** by [@mszadkow](https://github.com/mszadkow) — 2026-06-11T15:30:49Z

```diff
 		}
-		if quota.LendingLimit != nil {
+		if quota.LendingLimit == nil {
+			// Unset lendingLimit means all nominal quota can be lent.
+			lending = nominal
```

  The idea here was to kind of "auto-set" the value up to the nominal quota to not be misleading.
  But I get what you mean with the +inf, because if we don't set on purpose it should be something easy to spot in the metrics.
  Make sense to me
